item.title: Saudi Arabia: Transport Authority Conducts 73,180 Inspections In Early Ramadan, Records 14,474 Violations
item.description: The Transport General Authority carried out more than 73,180 inspection operations between 1 and 4 Ramadan across several regions of the Kingdom, particularly in Makkah and Madinah, resulting in 14,474 violations and an overall compliance rate of 88%. The authority said the inspection campaigns aim to ensure the provision of safe, high-quality transport services for pilgrims and beneficiaries. item.title: Saudi Arabia: Health Ministry Penalizes Beauty Clinic Practitioner For Filming Patients
item.description: The Ministry of Health announced it has taken action against a violation at a dermatology clinic after a healthcare practitioner filmed patients during laser sessions and published the footage on social media, in breach of the Law of Practicing Healthcare Professions. item.title: Saudi Arabia: First-Ever Sighting Of Golden Jackal Recorded In King Abdulaziz Royal Reserve
item.description: The King Abdulaziz Royal Reserve Development Authority announced the first sighting of the golden jackal within the reserve’s boundaries in Riyadh Region. The authority said the golden jackal’s (Canis aureus) first documented sighting was monitored using camera traps as part of its environmental monitoring program. item.title: Bahrain: Bank Card Fraud
item.description: The First High Criminal Court of Appeal has upheld a three-year prison sentence against an Arab defendant who attempted to buy a BMW 320 valued at BD25,000 using bank cards that did not belong to him. The ruling also includes a BD3,000 fine, permanent deportation after serving the sentence, and confiscation of the mobile phone used in the crime. item.title: Bahrain: MP Proposal For Teacher Hiring Database Platform
item.description: A single online platform to manage teacher recruitment under the Ministry of Education has been proposed by MP Mohammed Al Olaiwi, covering staff for public and private schools, colleges, nurseries and other education providers. item.title: Israel Launches Wave Of Strikes On Lebanon In Precursor To Potential Iran War
